name: agentic-factory
description: Local configuration and contract bootstrap for Agentic Factory

scripts.test: npm run deps:check && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-reporter=spec .test-build/tests/*.test.js
scripts.test:state: npm run deps:check && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec .test-build/tests/database/state.test.js .test-build/tests/database/synthetic-isolation.test.js
scripts.test:queue: npm run deps:check && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec .test-build/tests/database/queue.test.js .test-build/tests/database/recovery.test.js
scripts.test:simulations: npm run deps:check && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec .test-build/tests/simulations/*.test.js
scripts.test:sandbox: npm run deps:check && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec .test-build/tests/sandbox/*.test.js && python3 tests/sandbox/feasibility.py
scripts.test:intake: npm run deps:check && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec .test-build/tests/database/intake.test.js
scripts.test:telegram: npm run deps:check && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec .test-build/tests/database/telegram.test.js
